what: a spawn of Pazuzu, the Assyrian demon of the fever wind: a small, lean, sinewy winged demon that stands upright on two legs, painted seriously, grim and never cute. It has the snarling head of a gaunt hound: a long wrinkled dog's muzzle with a black nose, the lips drawn back from long ivory fangs, bulging round eyes, a heavy brow, two pointed dog's ears and two short blunt horns. Its skin is hairless, dark and leathery on the head, chest, arms and legs alike, and its thin chest shows its ribs. On its back it has four feathered eagle's wings arranged like the letter X: one big pair points up and outward above its shoulders, and a second, smaller pair points down and outward beside its hips, all four covered in broad overlapping feathers. Its legs end in an eagle's big scaly feet with long hooked talons, and behind it one thick tail of round segments curls up over its back and ends in a swollen black bulb with one curved needle-point. It has a small head and long thin limbs.
colours: very dark brown leathery skin, the colour of an old weathered bronze idol, nearly black in the shadows, on the head, body and limbs alike; dull grey-tan wing feathers with dark brown tips; dull yellow scaly bird feet with black talons; ivory fangs; amber eyes; a black tail sting; a dull green haze of breath.
wears: It wears nothing but a narrow ragged dark brown loincloth.
holds: Both of its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing: its right hand is raised high with the claws spread, and its left hand is held low and open.
pose: On two legs, it lunges to the left with its weight on its front taloned foot, its right claw raised high to slash, its left claw low, its four wings spread in an X behind it, two up and two down, its scorpion tail curled up high over its back, its hound's jaws wide open with one small puff of dull green breath touching the mouth, no bigger than its head.
must_show: a lean upright demon with a snarling hound's head
four wings in an X shape: two up, two down
an eagle's taloned feet
a scorpion's tail curled over the back
bronze-brown skin, empty clawed hands
grim and painted, not cute
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body

what: a spawn of Ammit, the Egyptian devourer of the dead: one real animal on four legs, seen from the side, heavy and low, made of three beasts joined in one body. Its head is the whole head of a Nile crocodile: a very long flat scaly snout with rows of big white teeth and a small cold yellow eye. Behind the head, its neck, chest and two front legs are a lion's: a thick shaggy dark mane round the neck and shoulders, a deep chest, and two strong front legs with big clawed paws, covered in short tawny fur. Its hind half is a hippopotamus's: a fat round hairless rump and belly of thick grey hide, and two short thick grey hind legs with broad blunt toes, and a short stubby tail.
colours: a dark olive-green scaly crocodile head with a pale cream lower jaw, white teeth, a yellow eye, tawny golden-tan lion's fur on the chest and front legs, a dark brown mane, smooth dull slate-grey hippopotamus hide on the hind half.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs with its body horizontal: it lunges forward with its front lion paws reaching and its claws out, its heavy grey hindquarters driving behind, its long crocodile jaws thrown wide open to snap, showing the teeth.
must_show: one beast on four legs seen from the side
a long green crocodile's head with open toothy jaws
a lion's maned chest and tawny clawed front legs
a fat grey hippopotamus's hindquarters
three clearly different parts: green head, tawny front, grey rear

what: a lesser Dullahan, the headless rider of the Irish back roads, dismounted: a headless horseman on foot. It is a tall, lean man's body in a long black riding coat, and the body ends at the shoulders: the coat's tall stiff upturned collar stands open and empty, a ring of black cloth with only a dark hole inside it, and above the collar there is nothing but plain backdrop. The only head in the picture is the one he carries: it sits upright on the flat open palm of his left hand, held out in front of his chest at the height of his belt, like a man carrying a lantern. The carried head is as big as a real man's head, cut off clean under the chin, a dead man's head with waxy grey-white skin, a huge grin stretched from ear to ear full of teeth, two round eyes glowing bright orange with no pupils, and lank black hair. He has long limbs and broad shoulders.
colours: a long charcoal-black riding coat with dull grey highlights on its folds and a row of dull pewter buttons, tall black boots with dull pewter spurs, black gloves, a grey-white waxy dead head with black hair and bright orange eyes, a whip of chalk grey-white bones.
wears: He wears a horseman's long black caped riding coat that reaches his knees, with a tall stiff upturned collar and a row of big pewter buttons, black gloves, and tall black riding boots with spurs. There is nothing above the collar.
holds: He holds exactly one cut-off head on the open palm of his left hand, low in front of his body at belt height, its face turned to the viewer. He holds exactly one whip in his right hand, and only in that hand: a whip made from a human backbone, a short black handle and then one thick line of big knobbly chalk-white vertebrae, each as big as his fist, as thick as his wrist all along. His right arm is raised high and the thick bone whip curls over in one bold arc above the empty collar.
pose: On two legs, he strides to the left with his weight on his front foot, his left hand held out low in front of him carrying the grinning head on its palm, his right arm raised high cracking the thick spine whip in an arc over the empty collar where his head should be, his coat tails flying behind.
must_show: a headless body: an empty collar, nothing on the shoulders
his own grinning grey-white head carried low on the left palm
one whip of big vertebrae in the right hand, raised
a long black riding coat and boots
orange glowing eyes in the carried head
must_not_show: man with a head on his neck

what: a nightshade spawn: a dead thing made of solid darkness, a very tall, gaunt, long-limbed figure on two legs, painted with real substance, never a flat shadow. Its whole body is one material: dull black, cracked and flaking like charred wood from a burnt-out fire, with ash-grey edges along every crack and ridge where the light catches, on the head, chest, arms and legs alike. Its head is long and narrow with no nose and no hair, two long horns of the same charred black sweeping straight back, a lipless mouth of long ash-grey teeth, and two narrow slanted eyes of cold white light. Its ribs and hip bones show under the charred hide. Its arms hang to its knees and end in very long, thin, hooked black claws. It has a small head and very long thin limbs, about nine heads tall.
colours: dull charcoal-black charred hide on every part with ash-grey cracked edges and highlights, ash-grey teeth, two cold white eye slits, a ragged dark grey shroud, a few dead dry grey-brown leaves and vines.
wears: It wears only a ragged dark grey burial shroud hanging from its hips in long tatters, and a few strands of dead, dry, withered grey-brown ivy that cling round its shoulders and one arm.
holds: Both of its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing: its right arm is stretched forward with the long claws spread to drain, and its left arm hangs low with the claws open.
pose: On two legs, it stalks forward to the left with a long stride, stooping, its weight on its front foot, its right arm reaching far out ahead with the claws spread, its left arm trailing low, its horned head thrust forward with the jaws open.
must_show: a tall gaunt figure of cracked charred black with ash-grey edges, not a flat silhouette
two swept-back horns and narrow white eye slits
very long arms with long hooked claws, empty
a ragged grey shroud and dead withered ivy
painted with depth and texture
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body

what: a star spawn: a thing that fell from between the stars, one great heap of grey flesh, a living hill, painted seriously with weight and depth, grim and never cute. It is one single heavy lopsided mound, wider than it is tall, soft all over, made of thick deep creases and heavy sagging rolls of wrinkled leathery hide that overlap one another, with black shadow in every crease, no two rolls alike. On its left side the heap rears up into one tall thick overhanging crest of the same wrinkled flesh, curling over at the top like a wave about to fall, twice as high as the rest of the heap; on the right the heap slumps away low. Scattered unevenly across the whole heap, on the crest and on the low slope alike, are five round black pits of different sizes, the biggest as wide as a quarter of the heap and the smallest half that, set in a crooked line from the upper left to the lower right, and deep inside each pit burns one small sharp cold white point of light like a far-off star. There is nothing else: it is only this grey heap and its five pits.
colours: dull dark grey wrinkled hide on every part, with charcoal-black creases and paler ash-grey highlights on the tops of the rolls, five pitch-black pits each with one small cold white light inside. No other colour anywhere.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The heap heaves itself to the left: its tall crest on the left side rears up and curls over, about to crash down like a breaking wave, while the rest of its mass drags low behind on the right, the pits staring out of it.
must_show: one heavy lopsided mound of wrinkled grey flesh with deep dark creases
a tall crest rearing and curling over on the left side
five black pits of different sizes in a crooked line, each with a small white star-light
no face, no head, no limbs
painted and grim: not a cartoon blob, not a skull, not a snail

what: a young marilith, a six-armed demon captain: a six-armed warrior woman in dark armour above the waist and one great serpent below. She has six arms, all bare bronze-tan skin and all the same size, three growing from each side of her body, one below the other: on each side one arm is raised straight up, one arm is stretched straight out sideways, and one arm is held down and out beside her hip, so that her six arms spread round her like the spokes of a wheel, and each of the six hands grips one curved sabre. She has a stern proud face with narrowed yellow eyes and long black hair bound up in a high tail. Her whole torso, from the throat to the waist, is covered by a high-collared sleeveless coat of blackened iron scale armour; only her face and arms are bare. At her waist, below a dark crimson sash, her body becomes one single enormous snake's body, as thick as her waist, covered in big dark red scales with black bands, which stands straight up under her like a pillar for the length of her torso, then winds into two heavy coils. She is small in the middle of the picture, with every sword tip well inside it.
colours: a coat of blackened iron scale armour, dark gunmetal-grey with dull steel highlights, covering the whole torso from throat to waist; dusky bronze-tan skin on the face and arms only; black hair; yellow eyes; blackened iron bracers and shoulder caps; a dark crimson cloth sash at the waist; dark red serpent scales with black bands; six curved swords with bright grey steel blades and dark bronze hilts.
wears: She wears a sleeveless coat of blackened iron scales, dark gunmetal-grey, with a high standing collar round her throat, which covers her whole body from the chin to the waist, front and back, with a small iron shoulder cap on every shoulder and a blackened iron bracer on every forearm, and a wide dark crimson sash knotted where the armour ends and the serpent begins. The only skin that shows is her face and her arms.
holds: She holds exactly one sword in each of her six hands, six swords in all and no more: six broad, heavy, curved single-edged steel sabres with wide blades, each as long as her forearm, all alike, each held up clear of the others. Every blade is gripped in a hand. No hand is empty and she holds nothing else. There is nothing behind her but the plain backdrop.
pose: She rears up tall on her coiled serpent body, facing the viewer, her six bare arms spread like spokes: two raised straight up, two straight out sideways, two down and out beside her hips, a sabre in every hand pointing outward, her head lowered and her yellow eyes on the viewer, the coils of her serpent half heaped beneath her. The whole of her, coils and sword tips and all, is well inside the picture with wide empty backdrop on every side.
must_show: a woman's upper body on a thick red serpent's coils, no legs
the whole torso covered from throat to waist by dark iron scale armour, plainly darker than her skin in the small sprite
six arms, three on each side: a top pair, a middle pair, a bottom pair
a broad curved sword in every hand, about six blades, not a fan of a dozen
a stern warrior's face, black hair tied up
must_not_show: bronze breastplate the colour of her skin
blades with no hand holding them

what: a sphinx of the Greek kind, the riddler at the crossroads: one animal on four legs with the whole body of a lean lioness, short tawny fur over the chest, belly, back and all four legs, a lion's long tufted tail, and two feathered eagle's wings growing from its shoulders. Only its head is human: the head of a human woman, as large as the lioness's whole chest, set on the furred neck: a sharp, clever, unsmiling woman's face with smooth olive-tan human skin, a straight human nose, human lips, a pointed human chin, and two dark human eyes under arched dark brows. Her dark brown hair is bound up close to her head in a knot at the back with one plain white ribbon round it. The fur stops at the neck: the face is bare human skin.
colours: short tawny golden-tan lion fur with a cream belly, a dark brown tail tuft, brown eagle's wing feathers with paler tan edges, an olive-tan woman's face, dark brown hair, one plain white hair ribbon, dark eyes, ivory claws.
wears: She wears only one plain white ribbon binding her hair. She wears nothing else: no crown, no collar, no gold.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, her body facing left, on four legs with her body horizontal: she crouches with her hindquarters low and one front paw lifted off the ground with the claws out, both brown wings raised above her back, her tail curled up behind; her woman's head is turned to face the viewer so the whole human face shows, one brow raised, her human mouth open, asking her riddle.
must_show: a lioness's body on four legs, seen from the side, furred all over
brown feathered eagle's wings
one human woman's face (nose, lips, chin, bare olive skin, no muzzle), readable in the small sprite
dark hair bound up with a plain white ribbon
no gold, no crown, no collar: plainer than The Sphinx

what: The Sphinx of Thebes herself, the one Oedipus answered: one animal on four legs with the whole body of a great, heavy, powerful lioness, short pale gold fur over the chest, belly, back and all four legs, a lion's long tufted tail, and two enormous feathered eagle's wings growing from her shoulders. Only her head is human: the head of a human woman, as large as the lioness's whole chest, set on the furred neck: a proud, cold, queenly woman's face with smooth pale ivory human skin, a straight human nose, dark red human lips, a firm human chin, and two human eyes with bright gold irises under straight dark brows. Long thick dark auburn-red hair falls in heavy waves down both sides of her neck onto her furred shoulders. On her head stands a tall gold crown. The fur stops at the neck: the face is bare human skin.
colours: short pale gold lion fur with a cream belly, a dark auburn tail tuft, great wings of white feathers with dark red-brown tips, a pale ivory woman's face, long dark auburn-red hair, a tall bright gold crown, a broad gold collar set with dark red gems, gold bands on the front legs, gold eyes, ivory claws.
wears: She wears a tall gold crown: a broad gold band standing up high above her brow like a Greek queen's, rising to a peak at the front and set with one dark red gem; one broad gold collar set with dark red gems round her furred lion's neck and chest; and a broad gold band round each front leg above the paw. She wears nothing else.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, her body facing left, on four legs with her body horizontal: she strides forward with her head held high and one front paw stepping out ahead, both great white wings raised and spread wide above her back, her tail lashing behind; her woman's head is turned to face the viewer so the whole human face shows, her chin lifted, her human mouth open, speaking.
must_show: a great lioness's body on four legs, seen from the side, furred all over
great white wings with dark tips, spread wide
one human woman's face (nose, lips, chin, bare pale skin, no muzzle), readable in the small sprite
long auburn-red hair and a tall gold crown
a gold gem-set collar and gold leg bands: the grandest sphinx
striding on four legs, head high: a queen's bearing
must_not_show: hair bound up in a knot

what: a phase spider matriarch: the ancient mother of the phase spiders, a real spider drawn very large, with the true body of a spider: a small head section, a huge, heavy, swollen oval abdomen behind it, three times the size of the head section, and exactly eight long, thick, jointed legs, four on each side. Her whole body is a pale, cold, icy blue, the blue of a winter sky, and her great abdomen is boldly marked with broad dark navy-blue bands across it and one big dark navy-blue diamond in the middle of its top. A ridge of long, stiff, white bristles like frost runs down the middle of her back and stands along her upper legs. She has a cluster of big bright cyan eyes and two very long, curved, white fangs. She is solid and clearly drawn except for the tips of her two rearmost legs, which thin out into a few short wisps of pale mist.
colours: pale icy sky-blue body and legs, broad dark navy-blue bands and one dark navy-blue diamond on the abdomen, white frost-like bristles and white leg joints, big bright cyan eyes, long white fangs, a little pale blue-white mist at the two rear leg tips. No green anywhere.
wears: She is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: She holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front and slightly above, she rears with her body tilted up, her legs planted wide to both sides and her two front legs lifted high and spread to seize, her long white fangs open wide, her huge banded abdomen raised behind her.
must_show: a true spider body with eight long thick legs, solid and clear
pale icy blue, blue not green
a huge swollen abdomen with bold dark navy bands and a diamond mark
white frost bristles and very long white fangs
big cyan eyes
heavier, older and more boldly marked than the plain phase spider
must_not_show: cloud of mist around the body

what: a lost ba, the soul-bird of an Egyptian tomb: a monster with the head of a human man on the body of a falcon. Its head is a real human head, as large as the bird's whole chest: the gaunt, starved, hollow-cheeked face of a dead Egyptian man, with ash-grey human skin drawn tight on the bones, a straight human nose, thin cracked human lips, a pointed human chin, human ears, and two sunken human eyes that glow pale yellow, ringed with black paint. The head wears a short, straight, shoulder-length black Egyptian wig with a blunt fringe. Its mouth is a human mouth, open wide in a wail, showing teeth. Below the chin it is all bird: a thin ragged falcon's body with dusty, tattered feathers and gaps in its wings, two long pointed falcon wings, a narrow tail and two scaly bird legs with big hooked talons.
colours: an ash-grey dead human face, a straight black wig, pale yellow glowing eyes, dusty grey-brown falcon feathers with a dull cream barred breast and dark brown wing tips, dull yellow scaly legs with black talons, one thin faded dull gold band round the neck.
wears: It wears a short black Egyptian wig and one thin faded gold band round its neck where the human head meets the feathers. It wears nothing else.
holds: It has no hands and holds nothing; its two taloned bird feet are empty.
pose: It swoops down towards the left with nothing beneath it, both ragged wings raised high above its back, its two taloned bird feet thrust forward and spread to snatch; its man's face is turned towards the viewer so the whole face shows, mouth wide open wailing.
must_show: a falcon's body with spread wings and talons
one human man's head (nose, lips, chin, grey skin, no beak) in a black Egyptian wig, readable in the small sprite
the human mouth open, wailing
gaunt, ragged and starved: dead, not a living bird
pale yellow glowing eyes

what: a stone giant: a carver of the deep caverns, a very tall, lean, long-limbed, hard-muscled giant man standing on two legs, calm and scornful. He is alive, and his skin is dark slate-grey, the grey of wet slate, hard and smooth as a river stone, on his head, chest, arms and legs alike. His head is long and hairless with a living face: a broad flat nose, full lips pressed shut, a long heavy chin, long flat ears and two small pale silver-grey eyes under a heavy brow. Bold patterns are carved into his own skin like the reliefs he cuts in the cavern walls: three thick pale grey spirals, one on each shoulder and one on his chest. He has no beard and no hair anywhere. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, very long arms and legs, about nine heads tall.
colours: dark slate-grey skin on every part with pale grey carved spiral lines on the shoulders and chest, pale silver-grey eyes, a long kilt of dark brown leather, a broad dark brown leather belt, a dull iron chisel and a wooden mallet hanging at the belt, one rough jagged lump of pale grey rock with chipped lighter faces.
wears: He wears a stonecutter's long dark brown leather kilt from his waist to his knees and a broad dark leather belt, with one thick iron chisel and one short wooden mallet hanging from the belt at his hip. His chest, arms, head and feet are bare. He has no armour and no metal on his body.
holds: He holds exactly one rock in his right hand, lifted high above his head on his straight right arm, ready to hurl: one rough, jagged, shapeless lump of pale grey quarry stone, twice as big as his own head, with sharp broken corners and flat chipped faces, plainly a rock. His left hand is empty: the arm is stretched straight out ahead, pointing at his target with the open hand.
pose: On two legs, he steps forward to the left with a long stride like a man about to throw, his right arm straight up with the jagged rock held high above his head, his long left arm stretched out ahead to aim, his hairless head lowered, his mouth shut in a thin line.
must_show: a tall, lean, long-limbed giant man with dark slate-grey skin on every part
a living face (nose, lips, eyes) on a hairless head, no beard
pale spiral carvings on his shoulders and chest
a stonecutter's leather kilt with a chisel and mallet at the belt
one jagged rock lifted high in the right hand, the left arm stretched out, empty
a calm carver, not a brute: no tusks, no long nose

what: a storm giant: the greatest of giantkind, a lord of the weather in his prime, a very tall, deep-chested, powerfully built giant man standing on two legs, proud and grim. His skin is pale blue-grey, the colour of a rain cloud, on his face, chest, arms, hands and legs alike. He has a stern strong-jawed face with glowing white eyes, long thick black hair blown sideways by the wind and a short thick black beard. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very broad shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale blue-grey rain-cloud skin, black hair and a short black beard, white glowing eyes, a dark navy-blue tunic with a bronze border, a broad bronze belt, bronze bracers and bronze greaves, a short storm-grey cloak, a greatsword with a bright steel blade and a bronze hilt, bright yellow zigzag lightning on the blade.
wears: He wears a knee-length dark navy-blue tunic pinned at the left shoulder only, leaving his right shoulder and half his chest bare, with a bronze border at its hem; a broad bronze belt; bronze bracers on his forearms and bronze greaves on his shins; and a short storm-grey cloak blowing sideways from his left shoulder. His head is bare: no crown and no helmet.
holds: He holds exactly one greatsword in his right hand, lifted high: a very long, broad, straight steel blade as long as his own body with a bronze crossguard, and one bright yellow zigzag bolt of lightning running along the blade from the hilt to the tip, touching the steel. His left hand is empty: a clenched fist thrust out in front of him.
pose: On two legs, he strides to the left with one foot far forward and his body twisted, his right arm raised with the greatsword lifted high above his head for a downward cut, the long blade slanting up to the upper right, his left fist thrust out ahead, his black hair and grey cloak blowing sideways, his mouth open in a shout.
must_show: a giant man with pale blue-grey skin, black hair and a short black beard
a dark blue tunic off one shoulder, bronze belt, bracers and greaves
one long greatsword raised in the right hand
bright yellow lightning on the blade
the left fist empty
a lord in his prime: no white beard, no breastplate, no circlet (those are the elder's)
must_not_show: lightning bolt held as a spear
cloud of mist around the body

what: a Titan of the Greek myths, one of the gods who ruled before Zeus, broken out of his chains in Tartarus: a towering, majestic, perfectly built man standing on two legs, with the bearing of a fallen king, straight-backed and terrible, grander than any giant. His skin is a deep burnished bronze-brown with a faint metallic sheen on the shoulders and arms, on his face, chest, arms and legs alike. He has a noble stern face with a strong straight nose, a heavy brow and eyes that glow bright gold, long thick black hair falling in heavy locks to his shoulders, and a long, full, curled black beard cut square at the end. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very broad shoulders, a deep chest, long powerful limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: deep burnished bronze-brown skin, black hair and a black curled beard, gold glowing eyes, a tall bright gold crown of long spikes, a long dark crimson robe with a gold border, a broad gold belt, a gold band on each upper arm, heavy black iron manacles with thick black iron chain links, brown sandals.
wears: He wears the regalia of an elder god: on his head a tall bright gold crown, a gold band with seven long straight gold spikes standing up from it like the rays of the sun; a long dark crimson robe draped over his left shoulder and wrapped round his waist, falling to his ankles, with a broad gold border, leaving his right shoulder and half his chest bare; a broad gold belt; a gold band on each upper arm; and sandals. On each wrist is locked a heavy black iron manacle as broad as his hand, and from each manacle hangs a short piece of broken chain: four huge thick black iron links, each link as big as his fist.
holds: Both of his hands are empty and he holds nothing: his right hand is a great clenched fist raised high above his head to smash down, the broken chain hanging from its wrist, and his left hand is a clenched fist held out in front of his chest, the broken chain hanging from its wrist. He has no weapon.
pose: On two legs, he strides to the left with his weight on his front foot and his back straight, his right fist raised high above his crowned head ready to hammer down, his left fist held forward before his chest, the two short broken chains swinging from his wrists, his crimson robe swinging, his head lowered and his gold eyes on the viewer, his bearded jaw set.
must_show: a majestic bronze-skinned man with a long curled black beard and long black hair
a tall gold crown of long sun-ray spikes
a draped dark crimson robe with a gold border, one shoulder bare
black iron manacles with short broken chains on both wrists
empty fists, the right raised high: no weapon
a king's bearing: plainly grander than the giants
must_not_show: chain held in the hand like a whip
long chain trailing on the ground

what: a primordial titan: one of the first children of Earth herself, older than the gods and never named: a mountain that has stood up and walks, shaped only roughly like a man, on two legs. It is made of bare broken rock and nothing else, piled up like a cliff: its body is one great leaning crag of dark rock with sheer cracked faces; each of its two arms is three big rough boulders, one after the other, touching, the last and biggest boulder being the fist; each of its two legs is a short thick pillar of stacked rock slabs. Every part is jagged slabs with slanting broken faces, none of them square, with deep black clefts between them. It has no neck and no separate head: high on the front of the crag, under an overhanging ledge, two small eyes of amber fire are set directly in the rock. The top of the crag and the tops of both shoulders rise into tall, sharp, jagged mountain peaks, five or six of them, standing up like the points of a great crown, and the tip of every peak is capped with bright white snow. A few tiny dark pine trees stand on its shoulders, showing how vast it is.
colours: dark slate-grey and charcoal-brown bare rock on every part, with black clefts and pale grey chipped edges, bright white snow caps on the peaks of its crown and shoulders, a few tiny dark pine trees, two small amber eyes. The rock is grey and brown.
wears: It wears nothing: its crown is the ring of snow-capped peaks that grows from its own head and shoulders.
holds: Both of its boulder fists are empty and it holds nothing: its right fist is raised high to smash down and its left fist hangs low by its knee.
pose: On its two thick rock legs, it lumbers to the left, leaning far forward, its left leg lifted off the ground in the middle of a great stamp, its right arm of boulders raised high beside its crown of peaks with the boulder fist on top, its left arm of boulders swinging low, its amber eyes on the viewer.
must_show: a leaning crag of bare dark jagged rock that walks: arms of boulders, legs of stacked rock
a crown of tall jagged peaks on its top and shoulders, capped with white snow
a few tiny pine trees on its shoulders
two small amber eyes set in the rock: no nose, no mouth, no separate head
one boulder fist raised, one leg lifted to stamp
rock, not flesh: no muscles anywhere

what: Ymir's Last Spawn: the oldest frost giant in the world, a child of Ymir from before the gods, a towering, enormously broad, mighty old giant man standing on two legs, the grandest and most terrible of all the frost giants. His skin is white as hoarfrost with pale icy blue shadows, the blue of a winter sky, on his face, chest, arms and hands alike, rimed and crusted with frost. He has a fierce ancient face with a heavy brow, deep lines and two eyes glowing bright cyan. His beard is enormous, white, and frozen solid: it hangs to his belt in a mass of long thick clear icicles. His long white hair is frozen stiff and swept back. A crown grows from his own head: a ring of tall, thick, jagged shards of clear pale cyan ice standing up from his brow, the middle shard the tallest. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very broad shoulders, thick long limbs, about seven heads tall.
colours: hoarfrost-white skin with pale icy blue shadows, a white frozen beard and hair with clear pale cyan icicles, bright cyan eyes, a crown of clear pale cyan ice shards, a great shaggy dark grey-brown mammoth-fur mantle and kilt, thick dark brown leather straps, a huge cream-white horned ox skull on the belt, a maul with a thick dark wooden haft and a huge rough dark blue-black boulder for a head, crusted with white frost.
wears: He wears a great shaggy dark grey-brown mammoth-fur mantle over both shoulders, standing up high behind his neck, a long kilt of the same dark fur, thick dark leather straps crossed on his bare frost-white chest, fur-wrapped boots, and as a belt buckle one huge cream-white skull of a horned ox with two long curved horns. No metal anywhere: he is older than iron. His crown is ice grown from his own brow.
holds: He grips exactly one great maul with both fists, his right fist high on the haft and his left fist low on the haft, so that both hands are on the wood: a long, very thick, dark wooden haft with a huge rough dark blue-black boulder lashed to its top with thick leather thongs as the hammer head, the boulder as big as his own chest and crusted with white frost and short icicles. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs with his feet planted wide and his knees bent, turned a little to the left, the great maul swung up over his right shoulder in both fists with the dark boulder head high beside his crown, about to smash down to the left, his head thrust forward, his frozen beard swinging, his mouth open roaring with one small white puff of frozen breath at his lips.
must_show: a mighty old giant with hoarfrost-white skin
a huge white beard frozen into long icicles, hanging to the belt
a crown of tall jagged ice shards growing from his brow
a dark shaggy fur mantle and a horned ox skull at the belt
one maul with a huge dark frosted boulder for a head, both hands on the haft
the grandest of the frost giants: more imposing than the jarl
must_not_show: clear ice block for a hammer head
fangs jutting from the lower jaw
cloud of mist around the body

what: a pixie swarm of the Cornish moors: five wild pixies flying packed tight together in one bunch, shoulder to shoulder and overlapping one another, so that the five of them make one connected group with one clear outline, painted seriously, feral and spiteful, never cute and never pretty. Every pixie is a tiny winged person: a thin, wiry, sharp-boned little human-shaped figure with a head, two arms and two legs, bark-brown skin, a narrow mean face with a long pointed nose, long pointed ears and a snarling mouth, a shock of wild dark hair, a ragged tunic of dead leaves, and two pairs of long narrow clear wings on its back. All five are drawn large, each one a third of the picture tall. They are bunched like this: two side by side at the front left, one above them, one below them and one behind, their wings, arms and legs overlapping so that no backdrop shows between them. Behind the five, joining them together, hangs one small thick round cloud of dull old-gold dust, which every pixie touches.
colours: bark-brown skin, wild dark brown hair, ragged tunics of dull moss-green and dead-leaf brown, pale amber dragonfly wings painted solid with dark brown veins, long black thorns, dull old-gold dust between the bodies, small yellow eyes.
wears: Each pixie wears only a ragged tunic of dead leaves.
holds: Each pixie grips exactly one long thick black thorn in both hands like a spear, as long as its own body, pointing forward to the left, and holds nothing else.
pose: The bunch of five pixies dives through the air to the left all together, the two in front with their thorn spears levelled straight ahead, the one above and the one below leaning in beside them, the fifth close behind, all their wings raised, all snarling.
must_show: five small human-shaped pixies (head, arms, legs) bunched in one connected group, not scattered
thin, pointed-eared, mean-faced, bark-brown: feral, not cute fairies
long narrow pale amber wings on each
a black thorn spear in the hands of each pixie, pointing left
dull gold dust behind them joining the group

what: a rot grub swarm: one single heaped, boiling mound of fat maggots, wider than it is tall, painted seriously as a grim real thing, never cute. The whole mound is made of about thirty big grubs piled over and under one another, every one touching its neighbours, with dark brown-black gaps between them so each grub can be told apart. Each grub is a real maggot drawn large: a fat, soft, legless, ringed body as thick as a man's arm, bone-white, tapering at the front to one small hard dark brown head-cap with two tiny black hooked jaws. It has only that plain cap at the front: the rest is ringed white body. At the top and the front edge of the mound six or seven grubs rear up out of the heap, clearly drawn, curving towards the left with their dark jaws open. Three or four old dark brown rib bones stick up out of the heap among the grubs.
colours: dull bone-white and cream grub bodies with grey-tan shadows in the rings, small dark brown head-caps with black jaws, dark brown-black gaps between the grubs, a few dark stained brown rib bones.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The mound heaves and spills to the left, piled higher on the left side, with six or seven grubs rearing up from its top and front edge and stretching to the left, their bodies curved like hooks, the rest of the heap churning.
must_show: one connected heap of many fat white grubs, with dark gaps between them
ringed, legless maggot bodies with small dark brown head-caps
several grubs rearing up clearly at the top and front edge
a few dark rib bones sticking out of the heap
grim and painted: no faces

what: a scarab swarm from a cursed Egyptian tomb: one single heaped mound of big black scarab beetles climbing over one another, painted seriously. The whole swarm is one connected heap, wider than it is tall, lying wholly inside the picture with empty backdrop all round it. It is made of about fifteen beetles, every one drawn large, each as wide as a fifth of the whole heap, packed shell to shell and piled on top of one another, every one touching its neighbours, with dull gold light in the narrow gaps between the shells so each beetle can be told apart. Each one is a real scarab beetle, an insect, seen from above: a broad oval body with a hard, smooth, glossy black back split down the middle by one straight line between the two wing cases, a small flat head with a toothed front edge like a shovel, and six short, thick, spiny, jointed black legs sticking out at its sides. At the top of the heap two scarabs have their black wing cases lifted open, showing short amber wings underneath, and at the left edge three scarabs reach forward off the heap with their front legs spread.
colours: glossy black beetle shells with a broad dull bronze-gold shine on the curve of every back, black spiny legs, short amber wings on two of them, dull old-gold light in the gaps between the shells.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The heap of beetles spills to the left, piled higher on the right and pouring forward low on the left, where three big scarabs scramble out ahead of the rest with their front legs reaching, the two beetles on top lifting their wing cases to fly.
must_show: one connected heap of about fifteen big black beetles, wholly inside the picture
real scarabs: oval smooth black backs with a centre line, six spiny legs, shovel heads
each beetle large enough to tell apart, with gold light between the shells
bronze-gold shine on the black shells so the mass does not read as a flat black blob
the heap spilling to the left

what: a stirge swarm: five stirges flying packed tight together in one bunch, their wings overlapping, so that the five of them make one connected group with one clear ragged outline, painted seriously, ugly and hungry, never cute. A stirge is a blood-drinking cave pest, part bat and part mosquito. Every stirge has a small round body covered in short dark red-brown fur, two wide hairless leathery bat wings of thin dark skin stretched between long black finger-bones, four thin hooked clinging legs, a small round furred head with two small pale yellow eyes and no ears, and, sticking straight out of the middle of its face in place of a nose and mouth, one very long, straight, stiff, thick needle of pale bone, as long as its whole body and as thick as its leg, tapering to a sharp point. All five are drawn large, each one a third of the picture wide. They are bunched like this: two side by side at the front left, one above them, one below them and one behind, their leathery wings overlapping so that no backdrop shows between them.
colours: dark red-brown short fur on the bodies and heads, very dark maroon-brown hairless leathery wing skin with black finger-bones, long bone-pale cream needles with dark red tips, small pale yellow eyes.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The bunch of five stirges dives through the air to the left all together, the two in front with their long pale needles levelled straight ahead like spears, the others crowding close above, below and behind, every leathery wing raised and spread.
must_show: five stirges bunched in one connected group, not scattered
leathery hairless bat wings with dark finger-bones on each
one long straight pale bone needle on each face, pointing left
small round dark red-brown furred bodies
ugly, hungry and painted: not cute bats, not birds
must_not_show: thin needle too thin to see

what: a gelatinous titan: a gelatinous cube so old and so vast that it fills a dungeon passage, painted seriously as a grim, dirty, ancient thing. It is one single enormous block of soft, wet, quivering, see-through jelly, a little taller than it is wide, seen from a little above and to one side so that its broad front face, one side face and its top show. It is plainly jelly and not stone: its faces bulge outward and wobble, its edges and corners are thick, soft and rounded, its top sags in the middle under its own weight, and its whole wet surface glistens with long soft streaks of reflected light. The jelly is translucent, dark and murky like deep swamp water: a dull dark olive-green, clearer near its faces and darker and cloudier towards its middle, so that the things inside it look dim, blurred and greenish, sunk deep. Hanging inside the jelly, held still at different heights and tilts as if floating in water, are the remains of everything it has eaten, each drawn large: two whole human skeletons, one upright and one upside down, three long dark swords pointing different ways, and one long spear. Everything is sunk fully inside the block. The block is only jelly and the things caught inside it.
colours: translucent dull dark olive-green murky jelly, darker brown-green in its depths, with soft pale grey-green wet highlights on its rounded edges, never bright and never candy-coloured; dim greenish-ivory skeletons seen through the jelly, dark iron swords and a dark spear seen through the jelly.
wears: It is a block of jelly and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; the skeletons, swords and spear are sunk inside the jelly.
pose: The great block of jelly slides to the left, its whole soft mass leaning and bulging forward on the left side like a slow wave, its top sagging and its sides wobbling, the skeletons and swords inside it tilting with the lean.
must_show: one enormous block of soft see-through jelly with rounded bulging edges: front face, side face and top showing
translucent murky dark olive-green, wet and glistening, not bright or candy-coloured
two whole skeletons hanging inside it, dimmed by the jelly
several swords and a spear inside it too
plainly jelly, not a stone block
no face, no limbs
must_not_show: glass box with a metal frame
sword sticking out of the block

what: a troll brute: a troll bred too big and too stupid, far heavier and thicker than a common troll, a hulking stooped giant on two legs with warty skin on every part. It is hunched and neckless, with a small head sunk low between enormous lumpy shoulders, a great sagging gut, and arms thicker than its legs that hang past its knees and end in fists as big as its head. Its small head has the troll face: a very long drooping nose, a slack open mouth with two blunt yellow tusks rising from the lower jaw, a low thick brow, tiny dull yellow eyes set close together, and long pointed ears. Several long pale healed scars cross its chest and arms.
colours: dark mossy olive-green warty skin on the head, body, arms and legs alike, paler grey-green on the belly, pale grey-green healed scars, dull yellow eyes, dirty yellow tusks and thick dirty yellow nails, a ragged dark brown hide loincloth, a frayed tan rope.
wears: It wears only a ragged dark brown hide loincloth held up by a length of thick frayed rope knotted round its gut. No armour and no metal.
holds: Both of its huge fists are empty and it holds nothing: both fists are clenched and lifted high above its head, side by side, to hammer straight down.
pose: On two bowed legs, it lurches forward to the left, hunched, its weight on its front foot, both enormous fists raised together high above its small head about to smash down, its slack mouth hanging open, bellowing.
must_show: troll face: long drooping nose, tusks, pointed ears
dark mossy green warty skin
a hulking neckless build with a small head, far heavier than the lanky common troll
both huge fists raised overhead, empty
only a loincloth and rope: no armour, no weapon
one head, two arms

what: a chaos troll: a troll that lived too close to a rift and now heals wrong, a tall, lanky, stooped, lopsided giant on two legs with warty skin on every part. It has two heads. Its thick neck forks like the letter Y into two separate necks: one head is high on the left, looking left, and the other head is lower on the right, looking right. Each head is a troll's: a very long drooping nose, a wide mouth of jagged teeth with two tusks, pointed ears and small glaring eyes. Its right arm is enormous and far too big, twice as thick and half again as long as its left arm, and ends in a huge hand with four long hooked claws like sickles. Its left arm is thin. From its left shoulder and down its spine grow tall, sharp, crooked spurs of pale bone, like broken antlers, where old wounds healed wrong. Its skin is mossy green blotched with big irregular patches of dull charcoal-black.
colours: mossy green warty skin with big blotches of dull charcoal-black on the heads, body, arms and legs alike, pale bone-white spurs on the shoulder and spine, one head with yellow eyes and one head with pale white eyes, dirty yellow tusks, long dirty bone-yellow claws, a ragged dark brown hide loincloth.
wears: It wears only a ragged dark brown hide loincloth. No armour and no metal.
holds: Its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing: the huge right hand is swept out in front of it with its long claws spread to rend, and the thin left hand is drawn back.
pose: On two legs, it lunges to the left, twisted and off balance, its weight on its front foot, its enormous right arm swung far forward and across with the sickle claws spread wide, its thin left arm drawn back, both of its heads roaring, the upper head facing left and the lower head turned towards the viewer.
must_show: two troll heads on a forked neck, one high and one low
one enormous over-grown right arm with long sickle claws, and a thin left arm
crooked pale bone spurs growing from the shoulder and spine
green warty skin blotched with charcoal-black
troll faces: long noses, tusks
no weapon, no armour: more warped than the troll brute

what: a war troll: a troll bred and drilled for an army, a tall, upright, broad-shouldered, powerful giant on two legs, standing straight like a soldier, with warty mossy green skin on its face, arms and legs alike. It has the troll face: a very long, thick, drooping nose that hangs down past its upper lip, a grim shut mouth with two big tusks rising from the lower jaw, long pointed ears and small hard yellow eyes. Its long arms reach to its knees and end in hooked claws. Thick dark iron armour plates are bolted straight onto its hide: big plain slabs of dark iron on its chest, both shoulders, its forearms and its shins, each plate fixed with a row of big round iron bolt-heads, with green troll skin showing between the plates. It has a small head and long limbs.
colours: dark mossy olive-green warty skin, dark grey-black iron armour plates with paler grey scratched edges and big dull grey bolt-heads, a dark iron helmet, yellow eyes, dirty yellow tusks and claws, a dark brown leather war-kilt with iron studs, a club of dark brown wood with pale grey iron nails driven through it.
wears: It wears heavy plain dark iron plates bolted onto its chest, shoulders, forearms and shins, each with a row of big round bolt-heads; a plain open-faced dark iron helmet, a round skull-cap with a strip down the back of the neck, that leaves its whole face, long nose and ears showing; and a dark brown leather war-kilt of hanging straps set with iron studs.
holds: It holds exactly one war club in its right hand, raised: one straight heavy length of dark brown wood as long as its arm, narrow at the grip and swelling to a thick rounded end. The club is brown wood from end to end. A dozen big iron nails are hammered through the thick end, and their pale grey iron points, each as long as a finger, stick straight out of the brown wood on every side with gaps of bare wood between them. Its left hand is empty: an open clawed hand held out in front, claws spread.
pose: On two legs, it marches forward to the left with a soldier's long stride, upright, its weight on its front foot, its right arm raised with the nail-studded club lifted high behind its head ready to swing down, its empty left claw held out ahead, its tusked jaw set.
must_show: troll face under an open iron helmet: long nose, tusks, green skin
dark iron plates bolted onto chest, shoulders, arms and shins, with big bolt-heads
one brown wooden club with big grey iron nails sticking out of its thick end, in the right hand
the left clawed hand empty
upright and drilled like a soldier: the best-armed troll
one head, two matching arms
must_not_show: full knight's plate armour with no skin showing

what: a vampire's thrall: a living human servant in the mould of Renfield from Dracula, a wasted, starved, half-mad man of fifty who has been fed a few drops of his master's blood, painted seriously as a pitiful and frightening wretch. He is alive, not dead, but ill: his skin is sallow grey-yellow like old candle wax on his face, neck, arms and hands alike. He is bent nearly double. He has a gaunt, hollow-cheeked, unshaven face with grey stubble, sunken temples, dark bruised rings round bulging, staring, ordinary human eyes with dark brown irises and white all round them, and a slack open mouth with a few crooked ordinary teeth, twisted in a desperate eager leer. His thin grey-brown hair is long, greasy and straggling, bald on top. His neck is scrawny and his arms are thin as sticks with knotted elbows. He has ordinary human ears and ordinary human hands with long dirty nails. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long thin limbs.
colours: sallow grey-yellow sickly living skin, thin straggling grey-brown hair, dark brown eyes with dark rings, a torn dirty off-white linen shirt, a ragged dull dark grey waistcoat, dark brown breeches, bare feet, a dirty grey-white linen bandage wound round the neck.
wears: He wears the ruined clothes of a house servant: a torn, dirty, off-white linen shirt with the sleeves in rags, a ragged dark grey waistcoat hanging open, patched dark brown breeches to the knee, and a dirty grey-white linen bandage wound several times round his throat, hiding his master's bite. His feet are bare and his head is bare.
holds: Both of his hands are empty and he holds nothing: he has exactly two arms, and both thin arms are stretched out in front of him towards the left, the hands open and the bony fingers hooked to clutch and throttle.
pose: On two legs, he scuttles forward to the left bent nearly double, his back hunched and his knees deeply bent, his weight on his front foot, both thin arms reaching out ahead of him with the fingers hooked, his head twisted up to stare at the viewer with bulging eyes, his mouth hanging open.
must_show: a living, wasted, hunched man of fifty with sallow grey-yellow skin
a gaunt face with bulging staring eyes, grey stubble and thin straggling hair, bald on top: mad, devoted, pitiful
a servant's torn shirt and waistcoat, bare feet
a dirty bandage wound round the throat
both hands empty and reaching, exactly two arms
no fangs, no cape, no claws: a mortal servant

what: a vampire spawn: a newly made vampire, drained, buried and risen within the week, strong, starving and feral, a lean young man still in the clothes he was buried in. He is dead flesh, never living: his skin is corpse-pale grey-white with dark grey shadows and thin dark veins at the temples and throat, on his face, chest, arms, hands and feet alike. He has a gaunt young clean-shaven face twisted in a snarl, with sunken cheeks, dark rings round eyes that glow bright red, a mouth stretched wide open showing two long white fangs, and lank, dirty, shoulder-length black hair hanging over his face. His fingers end in long sharp dark grey claws. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: corpse-pale grey-white dead skin on every part, lank black hair, bright red eyes, white fangs, dark grey claws, a torn dirty grey-white burial shirt stained with dark brown grave earth, ragged black trousers, bare grey-white feet.
wears: He wears only his grave clothes: a long, loose, collarless grey-white linen burial shirt, torn open at the neck and ripped at the hem and sleeves and smeared with dark brown earth, and ragged black trousers torn off below the knee. His feet are bare and his head is bare. No cape, no coat, no jewellery.
holds: Both of his clawed hands are empty and he holds nothing: his right hand is stretched far forward with the claws spread to seize, and his left hand is raised beside his head with the claws hooked to slash.
pose: On two legs, he springs forward to the left in a low predatory lunge, his front knee deeply bent and his back leg stretched out behind, his body pitched far forward, his right claw reaching out ahead, his left claw raised to rake, his head thrust forward with the fanged mouth wide open, his black hair and torn shirt flying back.
must_show: a lean young dead man with corpse-pale grey-white skin and lank black hair
red glowing eyes and long fangs, snarling
a torn earth-stained burial shirt and ragged trousers, bare feet
both clawed hands empty, lunging low
feral and ragged: no cape, no finery (those are the vampire's)
dead, unlike the living thrall

what: a vampire: the true vampire of the old Serbian graveyard reports, risen and grown patient and grand, a tall, lean, straight-backed gentleman who looks about forty. He is dead flesh, never living: his skin is corpse-pale grey-white on his face and hands alike. He has a long, cold, clean-shaven face with hollow cheeks, a thin high-bridged nose, arched black brows, steady deep-set eyes that glow red, and a thin-lipped mouth open in a slight smile that shows two long white fangs. His black hair is short, combed straight back from a sharp point in the middle of his forehead, with a streak of grey at each temple. His hands are long and pale with pointed nails. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: corpse-pale grey-white skin, short black hair with grey temples, red eyes, white fangs, a black knee-length coat, a dark grey waistcoat with small silver buttons, a white neckcloth, a long black cape with a dark crimson lining, black breeches and tall black boots, one dull silver ring.
wears: He wears the dress of a gentleman of the 1730s: a black knee-length coat, a dark grey waistcoat with a row of small silver buttons, a white linen neckcloth tied at the throat, black breeches, tall black boots, and a long black cape with a dark crimson lining and a tall stiff collar standing up behind his neck. One dull silver signet ring is on his right hand. His head is bare.
holds: Both of his hands are empty and he holds nothing: his right arm is stretched forward at shoulder height with the palm turned down and the long pale fingers spread, casting his charm on the viewer, and his left hand grips the edge of his own cape and sweeps it out wide to the side, so the crimson lining shows.
pose: On two legs, he glides forward to the left with a long smooth stride, his weight on his front foot, upright, his right arm extended ahead with the fingers spread in a hypnotist's gesture, his left arm flung out to the side holding his cape open like a wing, his chin lowered and his red eyes fixed on the viewer, fangs showing.
must_show: a corpse-pale gentleman with short black swept-back hair, clean-shaven, red eyes and fangs
a long black cape with a tall collar and a dark crimson lining, held open by the left hand
a black coat, grey waistcoat and white neckcloth
the right hand stretched out, fingers spread, empty
a grand, patient lord of the night: plainly above the ragged spawn
no hat, no moustache, no goblet (those are the vampire lord's)
must_not_show: something held in the right hand
